description: This source file contains a test suite for bug report generation and validation in an Android Cuttlefish environment. It defines tests for creating bug reports, verifying zip file integrity, and ensuring the inclusion of specific bug report files.

methods.name: TestBugReport
methods.description: Main test function that sets up environment, uploads artifacts, creates a bug report, and verifies the resulting zip file.

methods.name: createBugReport
methods.description: Creates a bug report zip file using the provided service and group name, returning the filename.

methods.name: assertZipIntegrity
methods.description: Checks that all files within a zip archive can be opened and read without errors, verifying archive integrity.

methods.name: assertAdbBugReportIsIncluded
methods.description: Verifies that the zip archive contains a bug report matching a specific regex pattern.
